style_base: Simple crude hand-drawn cartoon in the style of the 'Ecomonos' youtube channel. A recurring brown cartoon monkey character with big round white eyes and black pupils, thick bold black outlines, flat colors, expressive exaggerated faces — but in a DARK HACKER setting: dark near-black navy background, moody lighting, glowing green terminal-code and subtle red accents lighting the scene, the monkey often wearing a dark grey hoodie. Comedy-meets-noir tone. The SAME monkey character appears consistently in every image. CRITICAL TEXT RULE: prefer NO text, labels or signs at all — tell the scene through the monkey's action and expression and simple symbols. If a short text is truly necessary it MUST be in perfect SPANISH exactly as specified, in large simple block letters — NEVER English.
note: Mono-hacker oscuro. Gemini flash via Vertex AI. 31 escenas.

frames.text: Hay un rincón de internet gobernado por niños, tienen entre 11 y 26 años.
frames.scene: a hooded brown monkey hacker at a laptop in the dark, green code glow on its face, a few small shadowy hooded kid figures behind it, no text

frames.text: Y han robado cientos de millones de dólares, se llama Decom.
frames.scene: the hooded monkey holding a big glowing pile of stolen cash and crypto coins, dark background, no text

frames.text: Y no es un grupo, es un archipiélago de bandas conectadas entre sí,
frames.scene: a dark map of scattered islands connected by glowing green lines, a tiny hooded monkey on each island, no text

frames.text: la mayoría menores de edad.
frames.scene: several small child-sized hooded monkeys standing in the dark, glowing screens, no text

frames.text: ¿Y cómo caen ahí?
frames.scene: the monkey shrugging with open palms and a big question mark, green screen glow, no text

frames.text: Los reclutan jugando, en Roblox, en Minecraft,
frames.scene: the monkey playing a blocky video game on a screen while a shadowy hand reaches out from the screen toward it, no text

frames.text: les prometen dinero rápido y estatus,
frames.scene: a shadowy figure dangling bait in front of a small monkey: a wad of cash and a golden crown, dark, no text

frames.text: y funciona, Fardan de Rolex, de cripto, de Lamborghinis,
frames.scene: the monkey showing off a shiny Rolex watch, glowing crypto coins and a little Lamborghini, flashy, dark background, no text

frames.text: ese es justo su gran error.
frames.scene: the monkey facepalming with a red warning glow around it, no text

frames.text: A más de uno lo han pillado por subir una simple foto a Instagram.
frames.scene: a smartphone showing an Instagram-style selfie with a location pin, red and blue police lights reflecting on it, no text

frames.text: Pero cuando todavía no los pillan, lo que hacen a cojona.
frames.scene: the monkey looking nervous and scared, lit by an ominous dark red screen, no text

frames.text: Tumbaron los casinos MGM de Las Vegas y los dejaron fuera de juego varios días.
frames.scene: a neon Las Vegas casino building going dark and offline, a small hooded monkey with a laptop in front, no text

frames.text: Un chaval de 17 años filtró el GTA6 entero antes de que saliera.
frames.scene: a hooded teenage monkey pulling a leaked game city out of a computer screen, controller nearby, no text

frames.text: Han atacado a Nvidia, a Microsoft, a Samsung.
frames.scene: three big tech company buildings under attack (a green microchip tower, a windowed office, a blue tower), a tiny hooded monkey, no text

frames.text: Los daños, más de 500 millones de dólares.
frames.scene: a huge glowing mountain of dollars and coins in the dark, a tiny monkey standing beside it amazed, no text

frames.text: Su arma favorita, el SIM Swapping.
frames.scene: the monkey holding up a SIM card triumphantly next to a phone with a swap arrow, green glow, no text

frames.text: Básicamente, te roban tu número de teléfonos sin tocar tu móvil,
frames.scene: a phone number and SIM floating out of a victim's phone into the monkey's hand while the victim's phone stays untouched, no text

frames.text: y con eso entran en tus mensajes, en tus cuentas y en tu dinero.
frames.scene: the monkey unlocking floating icons of messages, a bank and a crypto wallet with a glowing key, dark, no text

frames.text: Ahora lo serio.
frames.scene: the monkey pulling off a playful mask to reveal a serious grave face, dark tone, no text

frames.text: Decom también tiene zonas muchísimo más oscuras y peligrosas.
frames.scene: the monkey cautiously peering into a dark ominous doorway glowing red, deeper into the network, unsettling but abstract, no text

frames.text: Tanto que el FBI ya no se anda con la edad.
frames.scene: a stern FBI-style agent silhouette shining a flashlight into the dark onto a small caught hooded monkey, no text

frames.text: Están cayendo penas de 10 años, de 25,
frames.scene: a monkey sitting behind prison bars in the dark looking at a wall calendar, no text

frames.text: y en lo más grave, de más de 80.
frames.scene: a small shocked monkey behind prison bars with a huge looming shadow number over it, no text

frames.text: Así que, protéjete, que es fácil, no uses SMS para tus códigos,
frames.scene: the monkey switching to a protective heroic pose as a glowing shield appears, and a phone with a crossed-out SMS icon, no text

frames.text: usa una app de autenticación,
frames.scene: the monkey proudly holding a phone showing an authenticator app icon (shield with a rotating code), reassuring green glow, no text

frames.text: no fardes de lo que tienes,
frames.scene: the monkey zipping its mouth shut and hiding its valuables behind its back, secretive, no text

frames.text: y desconfía de quien te promete dinero fácil por internet.
frames.scene: the monkey wagging its finger 'no' at a shady hooded figure offering a glowing bait of easy money, no text

frames.text: Porque en Decom, el que menos parece un criminal,
frames.scene: a lineup of several monkeys in the dark, one innocent-looking ordinary monkey subtly highlighted, no text

frames.text: suele ser el más peligroso.
frames.scene: that same innocent-looking monkey revealed with a sinister shadow and a creepy grin, dark, no text

frames.text: ¿Te flipa que unos críos muevan todo esto?
frames.scene: the monkey pointing directly at the viewer with wide surprised eyes, dark background with green glow, no text

frames.text: Suscríbete, que hay mucho más.
frames.scene: the monkey pointing at a big glowing red rounded button that reads 'SUSCRIBETE' in Spanish, dark background
